data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hēllē', meaning 'friend' or 'companion'. Wallie is a name that conveys a sense of loyalty and faithfulness. The name Wallie carries the meaning “Friend, companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wallie usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
